name: Šestajovice (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a white upper hoist part and a red lower fly part.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 1 February 1994 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
